meta.description: Infrastructure & Tools — 200 scenarios across LLM/Provider, MCP/Collaboration, Dashboard/IPC, Tools/Execution, State/Config/Metrics/Lessons

scenarios.description: setProvider switches from one provider to another and writes the change to .env via readEnv/writeEnv
scenarios.expectedBehavior: The provider key is written to .env, readEnv/writeEnv complete without file corruption, getCurrentProvider returns the new provider
scenarios.failureMode: writeEnv corrupts .env during concurrent access; setProvider succeeds but env file is truncated; getCurrentProvider returns stale cached value
scenarios.prerequisites: Valid .env file with PROVIDER key; llm-manager.js loaded

scenarios.description: addCustomProvider with an id that collides with a built-in PROVIDERS entry
scenarios.expectedBehavior: addCustomProvider detects the collision and returns an error or skips registration without overwriting the built-in entry
scenarios.failureMode: Custom provider silently overwrites built-in PROVIDERS[entry.id], breaking downstream validation; no collision warning logged
scenarios.prerequisites: Default PROVIDERS map populated in llm-manager.js

scenarios.description: quickSwitch between provider presets when the target provider's API key is not set in .env
scenarios.expectedBehavior: quickSwitch validates the target provider's key exists before switching; returns error with clear message if key is missing
scenarios.failureMode: quickSwitch succeeds despite missing API key; subsequent LLM calls fail with auth_error but the provider is now set; no fallback triggered
scenarios.prerequisites: At least one provider configured; second provider without API key

scenarios.description: testProvider sends a minimal chat completion and reports latency when the provider endpoint is reachable but returns garbage
scenarios.expectedBehavior: testProvider catches non-JSON or unexpected responses and reports failure with the raw response excerpt; does not crash the process
scenarios.failureMode: testProvider hangs indefinitely on streaming garbage response; or crashes with uncaught JSON parse error; or reports success on malformed response
scenarios.prerequisites: Provider configured with a valid endpoint that returns non-LLM data

scenarios.description: listProviders returns the provider list while a custom provider with special characters in its display name is registered
scenarios.expectedBehavior: listProviders returns all providers with proper escaping; special characters in display names do not break terminal output or JSON formatting
scenarios.failureMode: Unescaped characters in display name break JSON serialization; listProviders throws or returns truncated list
scenarios.prerequisites: Custom provider with special characters registered

scenarios.description: handleProviderError with a 429 rate_limited error triggers fallback chain to the next available provider
scenarios.expectedBehavior: handleProviderError returns { type: 'rate_limited', fallback: true }; caller invokes next provider in chain; fallbackModel from config is used
scenarios.failureMode: handleProviderError misclassifies 429 as auth_error; no fallback triggered; rate_limited type not recognized by caller; fallback loops infinitely
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple providers configured; rate limit hit on primary provider

scenarios.description: handleProviderError with system_role_unsupported when an OpenAI-compatible provider does not support the 'system' role
scenarios.expectedBehavior: handleProviderError returns { type: 'system_role_unsupported' }; caller rewrites the request with system prompt merged into user message and retries
scenarios.failureMode: system_role_unsupported not recognized by retry logic; same request re-sent to same provider; infinite retry loop; or request silently dropped
scenarios.prerequisites: Provider with type 'openai-compatible' that lacks system role support

scenarios.description: createLLMClient called for an anthropic-native provider type uses the correct SDK constructor vs OpenAI constructor
scenarios.expectedBehavior: createLLMClient routes anthropic-native types to Anthropic SDK and openai-compatible types to OpenAI SDK; returns appropriate client instance
scenarios.failureMode: Anthropic provider routed to OpenAI constructor causing silent failure; or OpenAI provider routed to Anthropic constructor; type check missing edge cases
scenarios.prerequisites: llm-provider.js loaded with both provider type categories defined

scenarios.description: buildCustomProviderConfig with an empty or missing apiKey field
scenarios.expectedBehavior: buildCustomProviderConfig returns an error or throws for missing apiKey; does not register a provider without authentication credentials
scenarios.failureMode: Provider registered without apiKey; all calls fail with auth_error but provider is now active; no validation warning
scenarios.prerequisites: User calls addCustomProvider with incomplete config

scenarios.description: All 11 provider presets fail simultaneously and handleProviderError chain exhausts all fallbacks
scenarios.expectedBehavior: After all fallbacks are exhausted, a clear 'all providers failed' error is returned; no crash; no infinite loop; logged at error level
scenarios.failureMode: Fallback chain wraps around to first provider creating infinite retry; or silently returns null/undefined causing downstream NPE; or crashes on last fallback
scenarios.prerequisites: All 11 provider API keys set but all endpoints return errors

scenarios.description: Local proxy on port 8788 receives a chat completion request exceeding MAX_BODY_SIZE of 5MB
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Request is rejected with 413 Payload Too Large before any processing; connection is closed cleanly
scenarios.failureMode: Server attempts to parse 5MB+ body causing OOM; or silently truncates without warning; or crashes the proxy process

scenarios.description: Proxy receives a request with deeply nested bracket structure that tests the bracket-balanced JSON parser
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Bracket-balanced parser correctly identifies matching brackets even with nested arrays and objects; parses the complete JSON body
scenarios.failureMode: Parser fails on deeply nested structures (>10 levels); returns truncated or unbalanced parse; hangs on malformed but bracket-balanced input

scenarios.description: EADDRINUSE when starting proxy on port 8788 because a previous instance is still bound
scenarios.expectedBehavior: EADDRINUSE handler kills the stale process or retries; logs the conflict and eventually binds successfully
scenarios.failureMode: Handler crashes instead of recovering; port stays occupied after stale process dies; handler kills unrelated process on that port

scenarios.description: Management cycle route receives a request but the routing logic misidentifies it as a screening request
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each route (management, screening, learning/analysis, general) has distinct path or header matching; management requests go to the management handler
scenarios.failureMode: Route matching uses fragile string detection; management request is routed to general handler; context window is wrong causing poor LLM output
scenarios.prerequisites: Proxy running; request with ambiguous routing keywords

scenarios.description: Proxy returns a response with malformed JSON that the calling code expects to parse
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Proxy returns valid JSON responses with proper Content-Type; calling code's JSON.parse never fails on proxy responses
scenarios.failureMode: Proxy response contains trailing comma, unescaped quotes, or truncated JSON; calling code throws on JSON.parse; position management silently fails
scenarios.prerequisites: Proxy active; management cycle sends request

scenarios.description: buildSystemPrompt called with undefined agentType parameter
scenarios.expectedBehavior: buildSystemPrompt defaults to GENERAL agent type when agentType is undefined; uses general context block ordering
scenarios.failureMode: TypeError accessing property on undefined; crash; or all context blocks omitted producing empty prompt
scenarios.prerequisites: prompt.js loaded; call without agentType argument

scenarios.description: buildSystemPrompt with MANAGER agent type includes all 10 context blocks (plan, learning, market, vault, rug, narrative, regime, attribution, portfolio, output schema)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All context blocks are present in correct order; portfolio and position data is formatted from the positions parameter
scenarios.failureMode: Context blocks silently omitted when optional data is null; duplicate blocks; blocks in wrong order affecting LLM attention
scenarios.prerequisites: All state inputs available: portfolio, positions, stateSummary, lessons, perfSummary

scenarios.description: buildSystemPrompt with an extremely large lessons array (>100 entries) causing prompt to exceed token budget
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Lessons are truncated or summarized; total prompt stays within typical 8K-128K token limits; most relevant lessons are selected first
scenarios.failureMode: Entire lessons array is included verbatim; prompt exceeds model context window; LLM call fails with context_length_exceeded

scenarios.description: compressToolOutput on discover_tokens output with 500+ tokens
scenarios.expectedBehavior: compressToolOutput applies tool-specific rule for discover_tokens; truncates to a manageable size; preserves top tokens by meaningful criteria
scenarios.failureMode: Tool-specific rule not found; falls through to recursiveCompress which truncates too aggressively losing all token data; or not at all exceeding context

scenarios.description: recursiveCompress encounters a circular reference in tool output data
scenarios.expectedBehavior: try/catch around JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data)) catches circular reference; returns truncated or original data instead of crashing
scenarios.failureMode: JSON.stringify throws uncaught TypeError; entire compressToolOutput crashes; calling code receives no compressed data and fails
scenarios.prerequisites: Tool returns object with circular reference (possible via some API responses)

scenarios.description: recursiveCompress depth limit of 5 is exceeded by a nested response with 7 levels of objects
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Truncation stops at depth 5; deeper levels are replaced with '[truncated]' or omitted; function does not stack overflow
scenarios.failureMode: Depth counter not properly tracked; recursion continues past limit causing stack overflow; or truncation happens too early at depth <5 losing data
scenarios.prerequisites: Tool output with deeply nested structure
scenarios.fileRef: compressor.js:recursiveCompress(72-100), depth limit check at line 80

scenarios.description: Array truncation in recursiveCompress reduces 50-item array to 6 items, losing meaningful data
scenarios.expectedBehavior: First 6 items are preserved; truncation notice is appended; compressed output is usable for LLM context
scenarios.failureMode: Truncation removes critically important items (e.g., removes all profitable positions retaining only losing ones); notice not appended causing silent data loss

scenarios.description: tryParseStructuredOutput extracts JSON from a fenced code block when the LLM wraps response in ```json ... ```
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Fenced code block is detected and extracted; outer markdown is stripped; JSON is parsed successfully
scenarios.failureMode: Regex fails for ``` with language hint other than 'json'; or for ``` without newline after opening; returns null causing fallback to raw text parse

scenarios.description: validateField receives a number for a field that expects a string_array type
scenarios.expectedBehavior: validateField returns false with a validation error message indicating type mismatch
scenarios.failureMode: Type coercion silently converts number to string_array (e.g., wrapping in array); invalid data passes through; downstream code crashes on type assumption
scenarios.prerequisites: Schema with string_array field; LLM returns number for that field

scenarios.description: validateField with nullable_string type receives an empty string instead of null
scenarios.expectedBehavior: validateField treats empty string as valid or coerces to null based on schema definition
scenarios.failureMode: Empty string is rejected causing validation failure; or empty string is passed through causing downstream null checks to fail

scenarios.description: extractLessonsFromStructuredOutput with 8 field names collects duplicate lessons across overlapping fields
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Duplicate lessons are deduplicated; only unique lessons are returned; order is preserved
scenarios.failureMode: Duplicates not filtered causing redundant lessons in system prompt; identical lessons waste context window
scenarios.prerequisites: LLM response with lesson data in multiple fields

scenarios.description: SCREENER role schema validates a token observation with extremely high market cap (1 trillion)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: schema accepts valid scientific notation or large number; no overflow in JSON parsing
scenarios.failureMode: Number overflow during JSON parsing; value truncated to MAX_SAFE_INTEGER; validation rejects valid high-value observation
scenarios.prerequisites: SCREENER schema loaded; LLM returns high-value token data

scenarios.description: LOSS_ANALYSIS schema receives an observation where loss reason is in Indonesian (Bahasa) mixed with English
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Schema accepts the mixed-language content as valid string; no language or encoding restrictions on string fields
scenarios.failureMode: Non-ASCII characters stripped or mangled during validation; loss reason becomes unreadable

scenarios.description: All 6 role schemas are loaded concurrently and one schema has a corrupt field definition
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Schema loading validates each schema independently; corrupt schema is logged and skipped; remaining 5 schemas load correctly
scenarios.failureMode: Single corrupt schema causes all 6 schema loads to fail; agent cannot parse any LLM response until fixed
scenarios.prerequisites: structured-output.js loaded; one schema has invalid field definition

scenarios.description: validateProvider returns success but the provider key in .env has trailing whitespace
scenarios.expectedBehavior: validateProvider or readEnv trims whitespace from .env values before validation
scenarios.failureMode: Key is read with trailing newline/space; API call fails with auth_error; provider appears valid but all requests fail
scenarios.prerequisites: .env file with trailing whitespace on PROVIDER key

scenarios.description: Proxy server crashes mid-request leaving hanging HTTP connection
scenarios.expectedBehavior: HTTP client times out after socket timeout; no resource leaks; server can restart immediately
scenarios.failureMode: TCP socket remains in CLOSE_WAIT state; port unavailable for restart; client hangs indefinitely
scenarios.prerequisites: Active request being processed by proxy

scenarios.description: buildSystemPrompt is called with positions containing a position that has null wallet_address
scenarios.expectedBehavior: position with null wallet_address is still included in prompt; format handles null gracefully showing 'N/A' or empty string
scenarios.failureMode: Null wallet_address causes TypeError in string formatting; position is omitted from prompt; agent doesn't know about active position

scenarios.description: compressToolOutput receives null or undefined data
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns empty object or null gracefully; does not throw TypeError on .method() calls
scenarios.failureMode: Null check missing; crashes with 'Cannot read property of null'; calling code has no compressed output
scenarios.prerequisites: Tool returns null; compressToolOutput called unconditionally

scenarios.description: handleProviderError with connection_error type (DNS failure, network unreachable)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: connection_error is identified; fallback triggers immediately without retry on same provider; error type is logged
scenarios.failureMode: connection_error treated as transient and retried 3 times on same provider before fallback; each retry adds 10s delay

scenarios.description: model_not_found error when the provider has deprecated the requested model
scenarios.expectedBehavior: model_not_found triggers fallback to fallbackModel defined in provider config; retry with correct model name
scenarios.failureMode: FallbackModel is also deprecated causing immediate second failure; fallback chain loops through all providers with deprecated models
scenarios.prerequisites: Provider with deprecated active model and fallbackModel

scenarios.description: setProvider called with invalid provider name 'nonexistent_provider'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: setProvider returns error indicating provider not found; current provider unchanged; no crash
scenarios.failureMode: Invalid provider name sets provider to undefined; subsequence getCurrentProvider returns null; all LLM calls fail

scenarios.description: readEnv returns undefined for PROVIDER key because .env file does not exist
scenarios.expectedBehavior: readEnv returns empty object or default provider; bot starts with default provider configuration
scenarios.failureMode: readEnv throws file not found error; bot fails to start; no default provider fallback

scenarios.description: Concurrent requests to proxy exceed available connection pool causing socket hang
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Requests are queued; each request completes in order; no requests are dropped
scenarios.failureMode: Socket pool exhaustion causes ECONNREFUSED; some requests are silently dropped; proxy enters deadlock state
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple concurrent LLM requests via proxy

scenarios.description: tryParseStructuredOutput receives response with ``` without closing ``` causing incomplete parse
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Parser detects unclosed fenced block; falls back to raw JSON extraction or returns partial data with warning
scenarios.failureMode: Parser hangs or returns truncated corrupt JSON; extraction of any structured data fails completely
scenarios.prerequisites: LLM response with unclosed fenced code block

scenarios.description: buildSystemPrompt with perfSummary containing null values for avgPnl or win_rate
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Performance summary is formatted with 'N/A' for null values; prompt remains coherent
scenarios.failureMode: null reference in template causes TypeError; entire prompt generation fails; bot starts with no system prompt
scenarios.prerequisites: No trading history; perfSummary.avgPnl is null

scenarios.description: ListToolsRequestSchema returns 28 registered tools but one handler throws during registration
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Failed tool registration is isolated; remaining 27 tools are listed and functional
scenarios.failureMode: Single failing handler blocks all 28 tool registrations; server starts with 0 tools; clients see empty tool list
scenarios.prerequisites: collaboration-mcp-server.js starting; one tool has invalid handler function

scenarios.description: normalizeEntry creates UUID-style id that collides with an existing entry in the JSONL store
scenarios.expectedBehavior: normalizeEntry uses timestamp+random combination that is statistically unique; collision probability is negligible
scenarios.failureMode: Random generation uses weak PRNG or truncated timestamp; id collision silently overwrites existing entry in append-only store

scenarios.description: filterEntries receives all 10 filter parameters simultaneously on a large dataset
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All 10 filters apply in conjunction (AND logic); only entries matching ALL filters are returned; performance is acceptable
scenarios.failureMode: Filter combination produces incorrect results due to operator precedence; or some filters silently ignored; or performance degrades to O(n^2)

scenarios.description: ensureStore called when the directory exists but is not writable (permission denied)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: ensureStore catches permission error and returns descriptive error; server continues running with degraded functionality
scenarios.failureMode: Uncaught EACCES error crashes the MCP server; or silent failure creates file in memory only; subsequent writes are lost on restart

scenarios.description: appendEntry appends a JSONL line while the store file is being read by another concurrent operation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Append and read are serialized via file locks or atomic operations; no partial lines are read
scenarios.failureMode: Concurrent read sees partially written line; JSON parse fails on malformed line; data corruption
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple concurrent operations on same JSONL store

scenarios.description: orchestrator-state.json has a next_id counter that skips a number due to a failed task creation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: next_id increments atomically regardless of task creation success; no gaps or duplicate IDs
scenarios.failureMode: next_id increments even when task creation fails; gaps appear in ID sequence; task with failed creation has no corresponding entry
scenarios.prerequisites: orchestrator-state.json loaded; task creation fails mid-operation

scenarios.description: Task advances from stage 'research' to 'evaluate' but the evaluate owner codex is not available
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Stage transition is allowed; a note is logged that owner is unavailable; task remains in evaluate waiting for owner
scenarios.failureMode: Stage transition is blocked because owner is unavailable; task stuck in research forever; no timeout mechanism
scenarios.prerequisites: Orchestration task in research stage; codex not running

scenarios.description: buildMemoryContext searches semantic memory but the semantic-memory.jsonl file is empty (0 lines)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: buildMemoryContext returns empty context gracefully; no errors; search results are simply empty
scenarios.failureMode: Empty file causes JSON parse error on first line; entire context building fails; task has no memory context
scenarios.prerequisites: Fresh install; no semantic entries yet

scenarios.description: logStageEvent appends to shared-agent-memory.jsonl when the file has grown to 100MB
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Append still works; no size limit check is applied; file system handles large JSONL files
scenarios.failureMode: Append slows down significantly; or file system quota exceeded; or read performance degrades for memory search

scenarios.description: persistStage called with an invalid stage name not in the 6-stage workflow
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Function validates stage name against known stages; returns error for invalid stage; no partial artifacts created
scenarios.failureMode: Artifact created with invalid stage; cannot be retrieved by stage filter; orphaned artifact in store

scenarios.description: autoSubmitWorkerResult is called with worker='gemini' but the result data is missing findings array
scenarios.expectedBehavior: autoSubmitWorkerResult validates required fields for gemini (findings); returns validation error; no partial artifact stored
scenarios.failureMode: Artifact created with missing fields; downstream orchestration reads undefined findings causing errors
scenarios.prerequisites: Gemini worker with incomplete submission data

scenarios.description: Codex auto-advances from 'execute' to 'review' when testing artifacts are missing
scenarios.expectedBehavior: autoSubmitWorkerResult for codex requires testing artifacts before advancing from execute; validation prevents premature advancement
scenarios.failureMode: Codex advances to review without testing; task reaches Claude for review without verification; buggy code is approved
scenarios.prerequisites: Codex worker active in execute stage

scenarios.description: workflow-artifacts.json next_id counter overflows after 2^53 tasks
scenarios.expectedBehavior: next_id uses BigInt or resets after reaching MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
scenarios.failureMode: Integer overflow causes next_id to wrap to negative or NaN; new artifact creation fails

scenarios.description: normalizeEntry receives a title that is exactly at the max character length with multi-byte UTF-8 characters
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Slice operates on characters, not bytes; multi-byte characters are not split; full title fits within limit
scenarios.failureMode: Slice on byte length splits multi-byte character producing broken UTF-8; JSON serialization fails on invalid encoding
scenarios.prerequisites: Entry with max-length title containing emoji or CJK characters

scenarios.description: tokenize-based scoring with a query that matches 50% of tokens across many entries
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Scoring function returns ranked results with scores reflecting token match density; top entries have highest token overlap
scenarios.failureMode: Scoring produces ties for many entries; ranking is non-deterministic; or score overflow with many token matches
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple similar semantic entries in store
scenarios.fileRef: semantic-memory.js:scoring logic (37-65): 8 pts per token match, 18 type match, 14 tag match

scenarios.description: mirrorToRuflo is called but the ruflo binary is not installed or not in PATH
scenarios.expectedBehavior: mirrorToRuflo catches execFile error; logs warning; continues without mirroring; semantic memory still works locally
scenarios.failureMode: Uncaught error from execFile crashes the caller; mirrorToRuflo throws instead of returning gracefully

scenarios.description: validateTaskPolicy called for a task with spec artifacts but missing plan and testing artifacts
scenarios.expectedBehavior: validateTaskPolicy returns error for missing plan+testing; recommends build artifact too; task cannot be finalized
scenarios.failureMode: Missing artifact check only warns instead of erroring; task is finalized without complete workflow; policy gate bypassed

scenarios.description: finalizeTaskWithPolicy called by agent 'gemini' instead of 'claude'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Policy gate checks agent name; rejects non-claude agent with authorization error
scenarios.failureMode: Agent name check is case-sensitive and 'Claude' (capitalized) is rejected; or 'gemini' is accidentally allowed to finalize

scenarios.description: validateTaskPolicy for a task where pending_agent is not claude but no Claude decision note is present
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Policy gate requires a Claude decision note when pending_agent is not claude; returns unmet requirement
scenarios.failureMode: No check for pending_agent identity; non-claude pending agent doesn't require decision note; policy gap allows unapproved actions

scenarios.description: Experiment minimum sample size check in policy gate when experiment has 0 samples
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Validation passes with warning that 0 samples provides no statistical significance; does not block but warns
scenarios.failureMode: Division by zero on sample size calculation; or 0 samples causes hard block preventing any experiment progress
scenarios.prerequisites: Experiment created but no runs recorded

scenarios.description: runGemini with a prompt that exceeds 120-second timeout
scenarios.expectedBehavior: execFile timeout at 120s rejects the promise; error result is returned with timeout message; process is killed
scenarios.failureMode: execFile timeout does not kill child process; orphan gemini process accumulates; memory leak over many calls
scenarios.prerequisites: gemini-bridge-server.js running; gemini CLI responds slowly

scenarios.description: gemini_analyze_file called with a file_path that traverses outside PROJECT_ROOT via '../'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: path.resolve resolves the path; startsWith check against PROJECT_ROOT rejects it; security error returned
scenarios.failureMode: path traversal not detected; attacker reads arbitrary files; or startsWith check bypassed with symlink
scenarios.prerequisites: gemini-bridge-server.js running; attacker has tool access

scenarios.description: ask_gemini called with context parameter exceeding 100KB
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Large context is passed through; Gemini CLI handles large input; response is returned
scenarios.failureMode: Context + prompt exceeds CLI argument limit; execFile fails with E2BIG; or stdin buffer overflows

scenarios.description: gemini_analyze_file with a file_path to a binary file (PNG, .so, etc.) that exceeds 50000 chars after readFileSync
scenarios.expectedBehavior: readFileSync reads the binary; slice(0, 50000) truncates to first 50000 chars; content is sent to Gemini (likely garbled)
scenarios.failureMode: Binary file contains null bytes causing string truncation before 50000 chars; or readFileSync throws on binary encoding

scenarios.description: mcp-server.js readJson helper called when the JSON file is valid but contains a BOM character
scenarios.expectedBehavior: JSON.parse handles BOM character gracefully; or helper strips BOM before parsing
scenarios.failureMode: BOM character causes JSON.parse to fail; entire file is unreadable; tool returns error
scenarios.prerequisites: JSON file with BOM (common on Windows-edited files)

scenarios.description: get_regime_memory computes win_rate as 0/0 for a regime with no trades
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Division by zero is handled; win_rate defaults to 0 or null; regime is still returned with 0 trades
scenarios.failureMode: Division by zero produces NaN; NaN propagates to dashboard; sortByNumberDesc fails on NaN values

scenarios.description: sortByDateDesc receives dates in mixed ISO 8601 and Unix timestamp formats
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Sort function normalizes both formats before comparison; correct chronological order is produced
scenarios.failureMode: Mixed formats cause type coercion errors; sort produces wrong order or throws
scenarios.prerequisites: Data with mixed date formats in JSON store

scenarios.description: StdioServerTransport stdin closes unexpectedly while tools are being called
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Transport detects stdin close; server initiates graceful shutdown; in-flight tools complete or are cancelled
scenarios.failureMode: Server continues running with no stdin; subsequent tool calls hang indefinitely; zombie process accumulates
scenarios.prerequisites: MCP server connected via stdio transport

scenarios.description: buildMemoryContext with semantic search returning 0 results and recent memory returning 0 entries
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Both empty results are handled; context is built with empty sections; no errors thrown
scenarios.failureMode: Empty array causes crash in context assembly code; task has no context at all
scenarios.prerequisites: Fresh collaboration store with no entries

scenarios.description: Two entries with identical title and summary are stored; deduplication on search returns both
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Semantic memory can store duplicates but search should ideally deduplicate or include both with identical scores
scenarios.failureMode: Duplicate entries corrupt scoring; one overwrites the other in JSONL; or both are returned causing redundant processing
scenarios.prerequisites: Duplicate entry submitted to semantic memory

scenarios.description: finalizeTaskWithPolicy succeeds but the corresponding workflow-artifact state is not updated
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Both policy gate state and workflow artifact state are updated atomically or in sequence with rollback on failure
scenarios.failureMode: Task is finalized in policy gate but artifact still shows 'in_review'; inconsistency between systems
scenarios.prerequisites: Task passing all policy gate checks

scenarios.description: persistStage creates artifact, advances stage, and logs to semantic memory but the middle step (advance) fails
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Partial failure handling rolls back the completed steps or at minimum logs the inconsistency
scenarios.failureMode: Artifact created but stage not advanced; semantic memory logged but artifact missing; inconsistent state across stores
scenarios.prerequisites: Network or filesystem error during persistStage middle step

scenarios.description: Gemini CLI returns non-zero exit code with useful error in stderr
scenarios.expectedBehavior: execFile catch captures stderr; errorResult returns structured error with both message and stderr content
scenarios.failureMode: Only exit code is logged; useful stderr context is lost; debugging is difficult
scenarios.prerequisites: Gemini CLI returns non-zero exit code

scenarios.description: Codex auto-submit includes changes array with 50 modified files; review step cannot handle large changeset
scenarios.expectedBehavior: changes array is stored as-is; review step displays all changes; no truncation of changeset
scenarios.failureMode: Large changeset overflows artifact JSON field; or review step times out processing 50 files

scenarios.description: Append-only JSONL store grows unbounded; no rotation or archival mechanism
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Append operations remain fast regardless of file size (O(1) append); reads filter efficiently
scenarios.failureMode: Read performance degrades linearly with file size; 1GB+ file causes multi-second reads on every operation
scenarios.prerequisites: Long-running bot with months of collaboration data

scenarios.description: Task owner is set to a non-existent agent ID; stage advancement is blocked because owner cannot be reached
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Stage advancement should detect unreachable owner and escalate or reassign
scenarios.failureMode: Task indefinitely blocked on non-existent owner; no timeout or escalation path; manual intervention required

scenarios.description: Search query with special regex characters (. + * [ ]) causes tokenize-based matching to malfunction
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Tokens are split on whitespace; special characters are treated as literal parts of tokens; no regex injection
scenarios.failureMode: Special characters interpreted as regex; search returns wrong results or throws on invalid regex
scenarios.prerequisites: Semantic memory entries; search query with regex metacharacters

scenarios.description: sortByNumberDesc receives array of numbers mixed with string representations ('42' vs 42)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Sort function coerces strings to numbers before comparison; correct numeric order is produced
scenarios.failureMode: Lexicographic sort ('9' > '100'); incorrect ordering; dashboard shows wrong top performers
scenarios.prerequisites: JSON store with mixed number types

scenarios.description: advanceOrchestrationTask called with a stage that is not in the sequential order (skipping from research to decide)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Stage advancement validates sequential ordering; rejects non-sequential jumps with error message
scenarios.failureMode: Stage is advanced non-sequentially; review step is skipped; code goes to production without review

scenarios.description: CRDT merge conflict when two collaboration servers concurrently append to the same JSONL store via NFS
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Append-only JSONL is naturally conflict-free for concurrent appends (no overwrites); both entries are preserved
scenarios.failureMode: NFS caching causes one append to overwrite the other; partial lines from concurrent writes corrupt the file
scenarios.prerequisites: Shared NFS mount; two MCP server instances

scenarios.description: Server starts on port 3000 but the port is already in use by a non-Node process
scenarios.expectedBehavior: EADDRINUSE handler uses fuser/lsof to identify the process; kills it or logs clear message; server retries
scenarios.failureMode: fuser/lsof not available in container; handler fails silently; server never starts; no useful error message

scenarios.description: First-time user navigates to dashboard root but walletAddress cookie is not set
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Server detects missing walletAddress; redirects to /wizard for initial setup
scenarios.failureMode: Redirect loop; or empty dashboard renders with no data; or wizard crashes because no config exists

scenarios.description: WebSocket server starts but an old connection from a previous session is still lingering with CLOSE_WAIT
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Old connection is detected and cleaned up; new WebSocket connection succeeds
scenarios.failureMode: Socket exhaustion from accumulated CLOSE_WAIT connections; new connections are rejected

scenarios.description: Log buffer streaming sends log lines to WebSocket clients faster than they can consume
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Backpressure is applied; slow clients are disconnected; server memory does not grow unbounded
scenarios.failureMode: Unbounded buffer growth for slow clients; server OOM due to accumulated log lines in memory
scenarios.prerequisites: Many WebSocket clients; high log output rate

scenarios.description: Auth token comparison uses regular comparison instead of timingSafeEqual
scenarios.expectedBehavior: timingSafeEqual is used for token comparison to prevent timing side-channel attacks
scenarios.failureMode: String comparison with !== is timing-vulnerable; attacker can brute-force token character by character
scenarios.prerequisites: Auth token set; attacker with network access

scenarios.description: Token is persisted to dashboard-token.txt but the file is world-readable
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Token file is created with 0600 permissions; only the bot process owner can read it
scenarios.failureMode: Default umask makes file world-readable; any user on system can read dashboard auth token
scenarios.prerequisites: Auth initialized; token written to file

scenarios.description: Request with both Bearer token and cookie token where they differ
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Server checks Bearer first, then cookie; if either matches, auth passes; explicit priority order
scenarios.failureMode: Differing tokens cause auth confusion; valid request rejected; or mismatched tokens both pass when one should fail
scenarios.prerequisites: Auth token set; request with both auth methods

scenarios.description: readBotState is called when state.json is temporarily missing (e.g., during atomic write tmp+rename)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: readBotState catches file missing error; returns empty state for that file; does not block dashboard render
scenarios.failureMode: File missing causes uncaught error; entire dashboard fails to load; state.json atomic write race

scenarios.description: hold_minutes computation in state-reader when deployed_at is in the future (clock skew)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: hold_minutes returns 0 or negative value is clamped to 0; no NaN or negative display
scenarios.failureMode: Negative hold_minutes displayed on dashboard; duration calculations produce negative values
scenarios.prerequisites: Clock skew between server and client; position with future deployed_at

scenarios.description: All 15 feature flags are exposed by state-reader but one flag name is misspelled in the exposure map
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All 15 flags are correctly mapped from their camelCase config paths; misspelling causes a flag to always return undefined
scenarios.failureMode: Misspelled flag always reads as falsy; toggle in dashboard appears to work but never changes behavior; operator confused

scenarios.description: Atomic write to config file via atomicWriteJsonAsync while another write is in progress
scenarios.expectedBehavior: withFileLock mutex serializes writes; tmp file is created with pid+timestamp suffix; rename is atomic
scenarios.failureMode: No locking; concurrent writes interleave; config file ends up as mix of both writes; corrupt config
scenarios.prerequisites: Rapid config changes from dashboard UI

scenarios.description: Dashboard writes a config value with an invalid type (string instead of number for a numeric field)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Config writer validates types before writing; rejects invalid types with error message
scenarios.failureMode: Invalid type is written; config.js reads it; type-dependent features crash with runtime type errors

scenarios.description: IPC message with a command larger than 64 characters is received
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Command validation rejects commands exceeding 64 chars with descriptive error
scenarios.failureMode: Overlong command is truncated; truncated command executes wrong action; security bypass via truncation

scenarios.description: IPC message with args array containing 17 items (exceeding the limit of 16)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Validation rejects args array with more than 16 items; error returned to sender
scenarios.failureMode: Args array truncated to 16 items without warning; truncated command executes with different intent

scenarios.description: IPC message with an arg exceeding 256 characters
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each arg validated individually; arg >256 chars rejected with error listing which arg failed
scenarios.failureMode: Overlong arg is truncated; semantic meaning changes (e.g., address truncated); wrong token acted upon

scenarios.description: Feature toggle map with dotted path resolution for a deeply nested key like 'screening.honeypot.enabled'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Dotted path is resolved correctly through nested objects; the exact leaf value is returned
scenarios.failureMode: Path resolution fails on intermediate missing key; returns undefined; toggle appears unset
scenarios.fileRef: dashboard/routes/api.js:feature toggle map (10-40), dotted path resolution (42-55)

scenarios.description: Smart wallet CRUD: add a wallet with duplicate address
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Add operation detects duplicate; returns error or silently ignores; no duplicate entry created
scenarios.failureMode: Duplicate wallet added; capital_pct calculations double-count; splitting logic sends duplicate payments
scenarios.prerequisites: Smart wallet already exists in list

scenarios.description: Copy trade: confirm action for a token that is already in an active position
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Confirm creates a pending intent; existing position check should warn; duplicate trade guard prevents double entry
scenarios.failureMode: Duplicate position created for same token; bot holds two positions in same token; PnL tracking confused
scenarios.prerequisites: Active position in token X; user confirms copy-trade for token X

scenarios.description: Block_rug_token action for a token that is already in the rug blacklist
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Action detects token already blocked; returns success with 'already blocked' message; no duplicate entry
scenarios.failureMode: Duplicate blacklist entry created; redundant checks on every screening cycle; wasted compute

scenarios.description: Kelly calculator endpoint receives extreme inputs: win_rate=0.99, avg_win=1000%, avg_loss=1%
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Kelly formula handles extreme values; returns reasonable fraction (capped at 0.25 or similar max)
scenarios.failureMode: Kelly calculation returns >1.0 (bet 100%+); capital allocation exceeds available balance; bankroll risk

scenarios.description: ALLOWED_LIFECYCLE_CMDS receives 'restart' which is not in ['start', 'stop']
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Command validation rejects 'restart'; only 'start' and 'stop' are allowed lifecycle commands
scenarios.failureMode: 'restart' is executed as 'stop' then no automatic 'start'; bot stops permanently; user must manually start

scenarios.description: Trash-wallets set operation replaces the entire list while concurrent screening reads the old list
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Atomic replacement ensures readers see either old list or new list; never a partial state
scenarios.failureMode: Non-atomic update; screening reads partially updated list; some trash wallets not filtered; scam tokens pass through
scenarios.prerequisites: Dashboard config update concurrent with screening cycle

scenarios.description: 2-second broadcast interval sends state updates to WebSocket clients even when nothing changed
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Broadcast should compare previous state hash; skip sending if state is identical; reduce bandwidth
scenarios.failureMode: Every 2s sends identical full state; bandwidth waste; client-side unnecessary re-renders

scenarios.description: readBotState reads vault-state.json but the file contains a corrupt JSON (e.g., truncated during write)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: JSON parse error is caught; vault state is returned as empty object; dashboard shows vault as empty
scenarios.failureMode: Uncaught JSON error crashes the read; entire state reading fails; dashboard shows no data for any section

scenarios.description: tmp file from atomic write is left behind after a crash; subsequent atomic write finds the stale tmp
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Stale tmp file is overwritten; unique pid+timestamp suffix ensures no collision; tmp file is not read as source
scenarios.failureMode: Stale tmp file is read as config source; stale config loaded; user changes lost after crash
scenarios.prerequisites: Crash during atomic write; stale tmp file exists

scenarios.description: Express static file serving for / and /wizard paths when the HTML files are missing
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Missing file returns 404; server logs warning; dashboard still starts for API routes
scenarios.failureMode: Missing HTML files cause server crash on startup; dashboard entirely unreachable

scenarios.description: Strategy override set_bulk receives an empty overrides object
scenarios.expectedBehavior: set_bulk validates that at least one override is provided; returns error for empty input
scenarios.failureMode: Empty overrides object is accepted; no change made but success returned; operator thinks overrides are active

scenarios.description: Token-blacklist CRUD: remove operation with non-existent address
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Remove returns success but logs warning that address was not found; no error thrown
scenarios.failureMode: Non-existent removal causes error or crash; or silently corrupts the blacklist array

scenarios.description: Wallet signals: check_rug_dev on a wallet that has been checked before; cached result should be returned
scenarios.expectedBehavior: check_rug_dev checks cache before making on-chain query; cached result returned immediately
scenarios.failureMode: No caching; every check makes fresh on-chain call; Helius rate limit exceeded; wallet check fails

scenarios.description: Dashboards writes a config value that requires a bot restart to take effect, but no restart prompt shown
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Config writer detects hot-reloadable vs restart-required keys; prompts user to restart for critical changes
scenarios.failureMode: No distinction between hot-reloadable and restart-required; user thinks change applied but new behavior not active

scenarios.description: All 5 files read by readBotState return simultaneously with large content; dashboard render is blocked
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Async reads are parallel non-blocking I/O; render starts as soon as first data arrives; progressive enhancement
scenarios.failureMode: Sequential blocking reads; total read time = sum of 5 file reads; dashboard hangs for seconds

scenarios.description: Kill stale process via fuser but the stale process is actually the current process (PID reused)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: PID check confirms process is different before killing; does not self-terminate
scenarios.failureMode: fuser kills the newly started server process thinking it's stale; server dies immediately after start

scenarios.description: Set_strategy for position limits with a value that exceeds the maximum allowed exposure
scenarios.expectedBehavior: API validates the new strategy against risk limits; rejects if max exposure exceeded
scenarios.failureMode: Strategy set without validation; bot opens positions exceeding safe exposure; liquidation risk
scenarios.prerequisites: Dashboard API reachable; position limits configured

scenarios.description: 23 ALLOWED_SLASH_CMDS are defined but one command has a typo making it unreachable via slash
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Command matching uses exact string; typo means command never matches; user gets 'unknown command'
scenarios.failureMode: Fuzzy matching accidentally matches typo'd command; wrong action executed

scenarios.description: cookieParser middleware fails on malformed cookie from browser
scenarios.expectedBehavior: cookieParser returns empty object for malformed cookie; server continues; no crash
scenarios.failureMode: Malformed cookie causes cookieParser to throw; Express middleware chain breaks; all requests fail with 500

scenarios.description: Dev-wallets CRUD: add operation with wallet address that has invalid base58
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Address validation checks base58 format; rejects invalid addresses with specific error
scenarios.failureMode: Invalid address added; downstream Helius API calls fail with invalid address error; screening blocked

scenarios.description: Rapid config writes (10 writes in 1 second) cause tmp file buildup or filesystem churn
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each write completes; stale tmp files cleaned up; no more than 1-2 tmp files at any time
scenarios.failureMode: Tmp files accumulate (10 tmp files per second); filesystem inode exhaustion on small partitions
scenarios.prerequisites: Dashboard UI with slider that triggers writes on every change

scenarios.description: execution-quality.json file is empty (0 bytes) after a failed write
scenarios.expectedBehavior: readBotState treats empty file as empty object; no parse error; data section shows empty
scenarios.failureMode: JSON.parse on empty string throws; readBotState fails for all files; dashboard shows no data

scenarios.description: Config change via dashboard triggers config-writer to write but the bot mid-read from config.js sees partial state
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Atomic write ensures readers see either old or new complete config; never partial
scenarios.failureMode: config.js reads during tmp+rename window; gets ENOENT or reads incomplete file; entire bot misconfigures

scenarios.description: Dashboard starts but no WebSocket client connects for 30 minutes; broadcast interval keeps running
scenarios.expectedBehavior: No-op broadcasts with 0 clients are cheap; server runs normally; logs periodic 'no clients' message
scenarios.failureMode: Broadcast to 0 clients still serializes state; CPU waste every 2s; log spam with 'sent to 0 clients'
scenarios.prerequisites: Dashboard running; dashboard.html not open in browser

scenarios.description: adaptiveSwap with multi-wallet DCA mode executes across 3 wallets; one wallet has insufficient SOL for gas
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Wallet with insufficient gas is skipped; execution continues on remaining wallets; partial fill is reported
scenarios.failureMode: Insufficient gas causes hard failure; entire DCA order cancelled; all wallets skipped
scenarios.prerequisites: Multi-wallet DCA configured; one wallet low on SOL

scenarios.description: Swap confirmation: runSafetyChecks detects SOL balance below gasReserve for a BUY
scenarios.expectedBehavior: runSafetyChecks compares SOL balance against gasReserve (computed from estimated CU); blocks swap with insufficient SOL error
scenarios.failureMode: Gas reserve check miscalculates; allows swap with insufficient SOL; transaction fails mid-execution; position partially opened
scenarios.prerequisites: Low SOL balance wallet attempting BUY

scenarios.description: Execute swap with split execution: 50% now, 50% later with random delay; the second half's delay exceeds the 90s tool timeout
scenarios.expectedBehavior: First 50% executes within timeout; second 50% triggers a new execution cycle; no partial fill without tracking
scenarios.failureMode: Second 50% is lost after timeout; split tracking state is lost; only half the intended position is opened

scenarios.description: self_update executes git pull but the working directory has uncommitted changes
scenarios.expectedBehavior: git pull fails or merges with conflicts; error is caught and logged; bot continues running without update
scenarios.failureMode: Uncommitted changes cause merge conflict; working tree is corrupted; bot enters inconsistent state

scenarios.description: self_update completes git pull and spawns restart, but the restart fails (port in use, config error)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Current process continues if restart fails; spawn error is logged; no service interruption
scenarios.failureMode: Current process exits before confirming restart success; both old and new processes die; bot goes offline

scenarios.description: Execution quality recording after swap when execution-quality.json is missing
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Recording creates the file if missing; appends quality entry; no error thrown
scenarios.failureMode: File creation fails due to permissions; recording is lost; quality metrics are incomplete
scenarios.prerequisites: First swap; execution-quality.json does not exist

scenarios.description: WithToolTimeout race: swap completes successfully but the timeout fires simultaneously
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Race condition is handled; timeout promise is rejected but swap result is not discarded; result is captured before timeout cleanup
scenarios.failureMode: Timeout fires before swap result propagates; successful swap is reported as timeout; position not tracked
scenarios.prerequisites: Swap duration near the 90s timeout limit

scenarios.description: swapToken dry_run=true mode: Jupiter quote API returns valid quote but price impact is 50%+
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Dry run returns simulated result with price_impact_pct=50+%; no transaction sent; warning included in result
scenarios.failureMode: Dry run simulates but doesn't flag extreme price impact; operator thinks trade is safe; enables live mode
scenarios.fileRef: tools/jupiter.js:swapToken dry_run (142-183), price impact in response (158-168)

scenarios.description: Jupiter Ultra /execute endpoint returns status='Failed' after successful /order
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Error response is parsed; error is thrown with descriptive message; swap is reported as failed
scenarios.failureMode: Failed status not checked; success=true returned despite failed execution; bot thinks swap succeeded
scenarios.prerequisites: jupiter.js swapToken called; execution fails on-chain
scenarios.fileRef: tools/jupiter.js:swapToken Ultra path (227-298), failed check at lines 275-277

scenarios.description: Jupiter order endpoint returns HTTP 429 rate limit but no retry logic exists
scenarios.expectedBehavior: 429 triggers exponential backoff retry (or error propagation); configurable retry count
scenarios.failureMode: No retry logic for 429; swap fails immediately; bot interprets as permanent error
scenarios.prerequisites: High-frequency trading hitting Jupiter rate limits
scenarios.fileRef: tools/jupiter.js:swapToken order fetch (240-250), no explicit retry for 429

scenarios.description: getJupiterPrice returns null for a valid mint because the mint is not in Jupiter's price feed
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns null; no crash; caller handles null gracefully with fallback price source
scenarios.failureMode: Null return propagates; caller does not handle null; bot uses null price in calculations; NaN PnL
scenarios.prerequisites: Valid mint not tracked by Jupiter price feed

scenarios.description: checkJupiterQuote with amountSol=0 results in 0 lamports quote request
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Zero amount is rejected by Jupiter API; function returns tradeable=false with appropriate error
scenarios.failureMode: Zero-lamport quote returns misleading result; function thinks token is untradeable when it is tradeable

scenarios.description: preSwapGuard with 15% price impact threshold: token has 14.9% impact (allowed) vs 15.1% (blocked)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Boundary condition is correct; 14.9% passes, 15.1% fails; no floating point precision issues
scenarios.failureMode: Floating point comparison: 15.0% may be incorrectly classified; precision causes intermittent behavior

scenarios.description: Hot/cold rotation: wallet hits consecutive error threshold; rotated to cold; next active wallet also errors
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Multiple consecutive erroring wallets are rotated through; if all wallets error, all are marked cold; no infinite rotation
scenarios.failureMode: Rotation loops infinitely through wallets that all error; no circuit breaker for all-wallet failure; log spam
scenarios.prerequisites: Multi-wallet config; all wallets hitting errors

scenarios.description: capital_pct split across 3 wallets sums to 101% due to rounding errors
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Validation accepts sum within 100% +/- small epsilon (e.g., 0.1%); rounds or adjusts to ensure exact 100%
scenarios.failureMode: 101% sum causes allocation logic to attempt over-allocation; last wallet gets negative adjustment

scenarios.description: Background recovery interval (60s) fires while the bot is in the middle of a swap
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Recovery checks are skipped or queued if bot is in critical operation; no concurrent modifications
scenarios.failureMode: Recovery runs concurrently with swap; wallet state changes mid-transaction; inconsistent wallet assignment

scenarios.description: getActiveWallet called when no wallet is configured and WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY is not set
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Throws descriptive error 'No wallet configured: set WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY or multiWallet in user-config.json'
scenarios.failureMode: Returns undefined/null; downstream code tries to use undefined.publicKey; cryptic TypeError

scenarios.description: isJitoEnabled returns true when jito.enabled=true but tipLamports=0
scenarios.expectedBehavior: isJitoEnabled returns false when tipLamports is 0; no zero-tip bundle submission
scenarios.failureMode: Jito enabled with 0 tip; validators ignore bundle; swap never lands

scenarios.description: Tiered tip multipliers: normal(1x), urgent(2x), critical(4x) with base tip of 10000 lamports
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Tips are correctly multiplied: normal=10000, urgent=20000, critical=40000
scenarios.failureMode: Multiplier applied incorrectly (e.g., urgent=10000^2); overflow on large tips; critical tip exceeds wallet balance

scenarios.description: Jito swap path: submitSwapBundle with 4 regions (fra, ny, ams, tyo); one region endpoint is down
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Submission retries on remaining regions; bundle lands on first responsive region
scenarios.failureMode: Single region failure causes entire submission to fail; no cross-region fallback
scenarios.prerequisites: Jito enabled; multiple regions configured; one region down

scenarios.description: Percentile-based fee estimation with 0 recent transactions in sample
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns FALLBACK_PRIORITY_FEE (50000) when sample is empty; no division by zero
scenarios.failureMode: Empty sample causes percentile calculation to return NaN or 0; swap uses 0 priority fee; transaction stuck
scenarios.prerequisites: First transaction; no recent fee history

scenarios.description: Helius priority fee estimate API returns garbage (non-numeric string) during congestion
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Garbage response is caught; fallback to FALLBACK_PRIORITY_FEE; error logged
scenarios.failureMode: Non-numeric value propagates; NaN used as priority fee; transaction fails or pays excessive fee
scenarios.prerequisites: Helius API reachable; congestion causes malformed response

scenarios.description: getMempoolSnapshot returns p50/p75/p95 with all values equal when all samples are identical
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Identical samples produce identical percentile values; no NaN or division errors
scenarios.failureMode: Identical samples cause percentile function to return undefined for some percentiles

scenarios.description: buildSelfTransferInstruction with TOKEN_2022_PROGRAM_ID creates 0-amount transfer for Token-2022 detection
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Instruction is built with TOKEN_2022_PROGRAM_ID; 0-amount transfer is submitted; Token-2022 detected by program ID
scenarios.failureMode: Token-2022 program ID not used; 0-amount transfer falls through to standard token program; detection fails

scenarios.description: classifySellSimError: 5 honeypot patterns (AccountNotFound, InvalidAccountData, Custom errors, AccountNotInitialized, owner mismatch)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each error pattern maps to a specific honeypot type; classification is deterministic and correct
scenarios.failureMode: Custom program error is misclassified as AccountNotFound; wrong honeypot type logged; learning data is wrong
scenarios.prerequisites: Token with sell restriction; sell simulator execution fails

scenarios.description: sellSimulator called on a token with 0 supply; transfer instruction succeeds but no tokens exist
scenarios.expectedBehavior: 0-amount transfer succeeds (no tokens transferred); function reports simulation successful but 0 tokens
scenarios.failureMode: 0-supply token reports as sellable; bot buys in but cannot sell; rug scenario

scenarios.description: fetchDS with 2 retries on 429; retry delay is 1200ms*retry count = 2400ms on second retry
scenarios.expectedBehavior: First retry: 1200ms delay; second retry: 2400ms delay; total wait 3600ms before failure
scenarios.failureMode: Delay calculation overflow; negative delay; immediate retry causing more 429s

scenarios.description: normalizeDex receives a DEX name it doesn't recognize from DexScreener API
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns the original DEX name unchanged; does not crash; downstream handles unknown DEX gracefully
scenarios.failureMode: Unknown DEX returns null/undefined; downstream code crashes on undefined DEX property
scenarios.prerequisites: New DEX listed on DexScreener not in pump/raydium/orca/meteora/letsbonk

scenarios.description: TF_BUCKETS mapping: 5m->m5, 1h->h1, 6h->h6, 24h->h24 but the API returns '1d' instead of '24h'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Timeframe normalization handles both 24h and 1d formats; maps to correct bucket
scenarios.failureMode: '1d' not in TF_BUCKETS; data for that timeframe is missed; 24h chart data unavailable

scenarios.description: getTopOwners via getTokenLargestAccounts + getMultipleParsedAccounts when token has 0 holders
scenarios.expectedBehavior: getTokenLargestAccounts returns empty array; function returns empty wallet list; no error
scenarios.failureMode: Empty response causes error in getMultipleParsedAccounts; function crashes or returns undefined
scenarios.prerequisites: Newly created token with no holders

scenarios.description: EXCLUDE_OWNERS list does not include a new popular DEX, causing its wallet to appear in discovered wallets
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Maintainers update EXCLUDE_OWNERS as new DEXes launch; unmatched DEX wallet is included but scored low
scenarios.failureMode: DEX wallet ranked high; bot copies trades thinking it's a smart trader; actually just DEX fees

scenarios.description: MAX_DISCOVERED_WALLETS=500; discovery returns 600 wallets; pruning by score descending keeps top 500
scenarios.expectedBehavior: 600 wallets sorted by score descending; bottom 100 removed; only 500 returned
scenarios.failureMode: Sort is ascending; bottom 100 (worst) kept; top 500 (best) discarded; bot follows worst traders

scenarios.description: Tool handler in toolMap receives unexpected parameter types; coerceBoolean is applied to a parameter that expects coerceString
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each coercion function is mapped by parameter key correctly; wrong coercion produces unexpected values
scenarios.failureMode: coerceBoolean applied to address parameter converts valid address to boolean 'true'; wrong address used for swap
scenarios.prerequisites: executor.js toolMap loaded; parameter with mismatched coercion

scenarios.description: confirmMode intercept via maybeParkAsConfirmIntent for non-SOL input token (should not intercept)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: maybeParkAsConfirmIntent only intercepts SOL->token buys; token->token or token->SOL passes through
scenarios.failureMode: Token->SOL sell is intercepted as pending intent; sell is blocked; position cannot be closed

scenarios.description: Pending intent with 5-min TTL expires while bot is waiting for user confirmation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Timer fires at 5 min; intent is removed from pending list; position is not opened; user must re-approve
scenarios.failureMode: 5-min timer never fires (setTimeout leak); expired intents accumulate; stale intents executed hours later
scenarios.prerequisites: confirmMode enabled; user does not respond within 5 min

scenarios.description: Jupiter Ultra API requires referralAccount param; configuration has null referralAccount
scenarios.expectedBehavior: referralAccount is only appended when config.jupiter.referralAccount is truthy; null/undefined excluded
scenarios.failureMode: null referralAccount appended as 'null' string; Jupiter API rejects malformed request

scenarios.description: getDecimals for a non-SOL mint that does not exist on-chain (invalid mint address)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: getParsedAccountInfo throws or returns null; catch block returns default 9 decimals
scenarios.failureMode: Uncaught error from invalid mint; swapToken fails before getting quote; premature error
scenarios.prerequisites: Invalid mint address passed to swapToken

scenarios.description: Jito bundle not landed (awaitBundleLanding returns landed=false with error status)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: legacyJitoFlow throws with descriptive error including status.err; swapToken returns failure result
scenarios.failureMode: Non-landed bundle treated as success; bot thinks swap completed; position tracked but never opened
scenarios.prerequisites: Jito enabled; bundle submitted but not landed

scenarios.description: swapToken Jito path: submitWithAdaptiveRetry exhausts maxAttempts; all retries fail
scenarios.expectedBehavior: After max attempts, error is thrown; swapToken returns failure result; no position tracked
scenarios.failureMode: Retry loop runs beyond maxAttempts; burning SOL on tip for each attempt; no circuit breaker

scenarios.description: Tool handler 90s timeout via withToolTimeout is reached during a long Jupiter quote fetch
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Race between tool handler and timeout; timeout wins at 90s; error is returned with 'Tool timed out'
scenarios.failureMode: Timeout race never resolves; promise leak; tool handler stays in memory forever

scenarios.description: trackPosition called with initial_value_usd=0; guard logs warning and uses amount_sol as fallback
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Warning is logged: 'trackPosition: initial_value_usd=0 for ... PnL will be 0%'; fallback to amount_sol is used
scenarios.failureMode: No warning logged; initial_value_usd stays 0; PnL always reads 0%; performance metrics are wrong

scenarios.description: trackPosition and recordClose race via concurrent calls; _writeQueue serializes them
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Both writes are queued; first write completes, then second write; state is consistent after both
scenarios.failureMode: No serialization; second write overwrites first; position close data lost

scenarios.description: flushState called before process.exit(); _writeQueue drain completes before exit
scenarios.expectedBehavior: flushState awaits _writeQueue; drain completes; process exits safely without data loss
scenarios.failureMode: flushState not called; partial write in queue is abandoned; last position update lost

scenarios.description: cleanStaleTestPositions with a position key like 'validMint::walletB' where validMint is 44 chars
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Position with 44-char mint is kept; only keys with invalid mint length (32-44 validation) are cleaned
scenarios.failureMode: Valid 44-char mint is incorrectly classified as invalid; legitimate position deleted
scenarios.prerequisites: Positions with multi-wallet keys; valid 44-char mint addresses

scenarios.description: syncOpenPositions with active_addresses list; five positions missing; only 2 are past the 5-min grace period
scenarios.expectedBehavior: 2 positions past grace period are auto-closed; 3 within grace period are skipped with log message
scenarios.failureMode: All 5 are closed regardless of grace period; newly deployed positions are lost
scenarios.prerequisites: Positions deployed within last 5 minutes; sync triggered

scenarios.description: updatePeakPnl called with lower PnL than current peak; update correctly rejected
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Only higher PnL updates are accepted; lower value returns null; peak stays at highest value
scenarios.failureMode: Lower PnL overwrites peak; trailing stop resets to lower level; premature sell on next dip
scenarios.prerequisites: Position with peak_pnl_pct=50%; updatePeakPnl called with 30%

scenarios.description: sanitizeStoredText receives text containing HTML/control characters; strips < > ` and trims to 280 chars
scenarios.expectedBehavior: HTML tags, backticks, control characters are stripped; text is trimmed and truncated to MAX_INSTRUCTION_LENGTH
scenarios.failureMode: Replacement regex fails on multi-byte chars; null byte not removed; truncated text splits multi-byte char

scenarios.description: markPartialTPDone called twice for same position; second call should be no-op
scenarios.expectedBehavior: First call sets partial_tp_done=true; second call finds flag already set and returns early (or is idempotent)
scenarios.failureMode: Second call resets partial_tp_done to true with new timestamp; duplicate partial-TP execution

scenarios.description: buildVaultConfig with 4-level nested config fallback; all levels empty
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns default vault config; no errors; all required fields have sensible defaults
scenarios.failureMode: Missing fallback at any level returns undefined; downstream vault code crashes on undefined access

scenarios.description: Config tree: screening section has 28+ parameters; one parameter has a default value that conflicts with another
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All defaults are independently valid; no contradictory defaults (e.g., minSupply > maxSupply)
scenarios.failureMode: Contradictory defaults cause validation loops; filters always reject tokens; bot never buys

scenarios.description: kelly configuration has fraction=0.0 (bet nothing)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Kelly fraction of 0 means no position sizing; bot does not allocate capital; acceptable configuration
scenarios.failureMode: 0 fraction causes division by zero in capital sizing; or disables trading entirely without clear error

scenarios.description: Rolling 200-sample window reaches 200; new sample pushes out oldest; window maintains correct size
scenarios.expectedBehavior: New sample is added; oldest is removed; window stays at exactly 200 samples
scenarios.failureMode: Window grows beyond 200; memory usage increases; metrics become less representative

scenarios.description: startTimer via process.hrtime.bigint() and elapsedMs conversion; timer runs for 1 hour
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Bigint subtraction correctly handles large nanosecond values; elapsed_ms returns correct hours
scenarios.failureMode: Bigint overflow or precision loss; elapsed_ms returns wrong value after long durations

scenarios.description: 60s persist throttle: 5 rapid metric updates within 1 second; only 1 persist should occur
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Throttle allows first persist; subsequent updates within 60s are batched; only 1 disk write
scenarios.failureMode: All 5 updates trigger disk writes; 60s throttle not working; excessive I/O on every metric change
scenarios.prerequisites: Rapid metric updates; metrics tracking active

scenarios.description: getStats returns session_uptime_ms while counters and gauges have never been incremented
scenarios.expectedBehavior: session_uptime_ms is accurate; counters are 0; gauges are default values; no errors
scenarios.failureMode: Uninitialized counters return undefined or NaN; dashboard shows 'undefined' for all metrics
scenarios.prerequisites: Fresh bot start; no trades yet

scenarios.description: addLesson called with no parameters; lesson has null title and null body
scenarios.expectedBehavior: addLesson validates required fields; returns error if title is missing
scenarios.failureMode: Lesson with null/undefined fields created; downstream rendering crashes on null access

scenarios.description: pinLesson/unpinLesson: pin a lesson that is already pinned
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Pin operation is idempotent; lesson stays pinned; no duplicate pin entry
scenarios.failureMode: Pinning increments some counter each time; lesson appears multiple times in pinned list

scenarios.description: getLessonsForPrompt returns pinned first, then role-specific, then general; 0 pinned and 0 role-specific lessons
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns only general lessons; no errors; correct sort order with empty sections
scenarios.failureMode: Empty sections cause crash in sort/merge logic; no lessons returned; prompt has no learning context
scenarios.prerequisites: No pinned or role-specific lessons exist

scenarios.description: recordLessonOutcome with win_rate <40% after 30 uses triggers auto-deprecation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Lesson is auto-deprecated; marked as deprecated; not returned in prompt; log entry created
scenarios.failureMode: Auto-deprecation threshold not checked; underperforming lesson still in prompt; wastes context
scenarios.prerequisites: Lesson with 30+ uses and <40% win rate

scenarios.description: recordTradeOutcome with PnL drift >5% triggers warning; drift is calculated from expected vs actual
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Warning is logged with drift percentage; trade outcome is still recorded; investigation triggered
scenarios.failureMode: Drift >5% not detected; trade recorded with wrong PnL; learning system trains on incorrect data
scenarios.prerequisites: Trade with significant slippage or failed partially

scenarios.description: recordTradeOutcome with rug detection; auto-generates lesson for rug and fast dump patterns
scenarios.expectedBehavior: New lesson is auto-generated with details from rug event; lesson is added to lessons list; prompt includes new lesson
scenarios.failureMode: Auto-generated lesson has generic text that is not useful; duplicates existing lesson; no dedup check

scenarios.description: getPerformanceSummary with 0 trades returns avgPnl=0, avgHold=0, win_rate=0
scenarios.expectedBehavior: All values return 0; no division by zero; summary is valid JSON object
scenarios.failureMode: Division by zero produces NaN for win_rate; dashboard shows NaN%

scenarios.description: atomicWriteJsonAsync with a file path that has no write permission
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Write fails with EACCES; tmp file is cleaned up; error is logged; caller receives error
scenarios.failureMode: Tmp file is left behind; error not thrown; caller thinks write succeeded

scenarios.description: withFileLock mutex per absolute path: two concurrent writes to different files do not block each other
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Each file has independent mutex; concurrent writes to different files proceed in parallel
scenarios.failureMode: Global mutex serializes all writes; state.json and config.json writes block each other
scenarios.prerequisites: Concurrent writes to state.json and config.json

scenarios.description: pruneClosedPositions with maxAgeDays=7; position closed 8 days ago should be pruned
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Position closed 8 days ago is removed; state is saved; clean count incremented
scenarios.failureMode: Date comparison incorrect (e.g., using days instead of ms); position not pruned; state file grows

scenarios.description: Deduplication by position_key+closed_at composite key fails when a position was closed and re-opened with same key
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Composite key ensures uniqueness; reopened position has different closed_at; both entries kept if open
scenarios.failureMode: Only position_key used for dedup; reopened position removes closed record; historical data lost
scenarios.prerequisites: Position reopened with same key after being closed

scenarios.description: Circuit breaker trips at BREAKER_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_ERRORS=3 for a feature; third consecutive error disables it
scenarios.expectedBehavior: After third consecutive error, feature is disabled; subsequent calls return 'circuit open'; error is logged
scenarios.failureMode: Breaker trips at 2 errors (off-by-one); or never trips due to counter reset bug

scenarios.description: autoResetBreakers at maxAgeMs=10min: breaker tripped 9 min ago should NOT be reset
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Only breakers older than 10 minutes are reset; 9-min-old breaker stays open
scenarios.failureMode: 9-min-old breaker is reset prematurely; feature re-enabled while root cause still exists

scenarios.description: getHealthReport computes error_rate_pct as 0/0 when no calls have been made to the feature
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns 0 for error_rate_pct; no division by zero; health report is valid
scenarios.failureMode: Division by zero; NaN propagates; health dashboard shows NaN% error rate

scenarios.description: normalizeBooleanFlag receives unknown string 'maybe'
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns false for unknown strings; only true for '1'/'true'/'yes'/'on'; false for '0'/'false'/'no'/'off'
scenarios.failureMode: Unknown string returns undefined; downstream truthy check treats undefined as false; ambiguous behavior

scenarios.description: Devnet auto-detection via RPC URL containing 'devnet' while using Helius devnet endpoint
scenarios.expectedBehavior: RPC URL 'https://devnet.helius-rpc.com' contains 'devnet'; auto-detection sets DEMO mode; DRY_RUN becomes true
scenarios.failureMode: Substring check is case-sensitive and 'Devnet' (capitalized) not detected; live mode on devnet; wasted real fees

scenarios.description: demoMode=true and dryRun=true both set; demoMode should imply dryRun regardless
scenarios.expectedBehavior: demoMode sets DRY_RUN=true; explicit dryRun=true is redundant but harmless
scenarios.failureMode: demoMode does not set DRY_RUN; demo bot executes real transactions; real SOL lost

scenarios.description: Cold start: RPC_URL check when no RPC is configured; state.json missing; file missing=warning behavior
scenarios.expectedBehavior: dataFileCheck for state.json returns warning status; cold start is detected; bot continues setup flow
scenarios.failureMode: Missing state.json is treated as error; bot refuses to start even on first run
scenarios.prerequisites: Fresh install; no RPC_URL, no state.json

scenarios.description: Insufficient data: rug memory with only 10 entries (threshold is 15); file exists but below threshold=error
scenarios.expectedBehavior: File exists (10 entries) but below threshold (15); returns error status; rug protection not fully active
scenarios.failureMode: File exists but below threshold reported as warning instead of error; rug protection insufficient
scenarios.fileRef: readiness.js:insufficient data check (24-40), rug memory threshold (30)

scenarios.description: assertOperationalReadiness throws in live mode when readiness checks fail
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Error is thrown with all failing check details; bot does not enter live trading without passing readiness
scenarios.failureMode: Warning-level failure does not throw; bot enters live mode with degraded capabilities
scenarios.prerequisites: Live mode; some readiness checks failing

scenarios.description: ConfirmMode readiness check when Telegram is not configured (no bot token, no chat ID)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: ConfirmMode readiness fails; mode cannot be enabled without Telegram for sending confirm prompts
scenarios.failureMode: ConfirmMode enabled without Telegram; pending intents are created but never confirmed; positions stuck in limbo

scenarios.description: Regime memory check: threshold=5; only 3 regimes stored; file exists but insufficient
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Returns error status; insufficient regime memory for reliable regime-aware trading
scenarios.failureMode: Only checks file existence; 3 regimes accepted as sufficient; regime detection unreliable

scenarios.description: 8 default features with weights summing to 1.17 (not normalized to 1.0); multi-criteria decision uses raw weights
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Weights are used as-is; total >1.0 means some decisions get disproportionate feature influence
scenarios.failureMode: Unnormalized weights cause decision bias; features with lower weights are never selected
scenarios.prerequisites: Feature registry loaded with default weights

scenarios.description: config.js loads a user-config.json with a key that has been deprecated but still present for backward compatibility
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Deprecated key is read but mapped to new config path; warning is logged; new config path takes precedence
scenarios.failureMode: Deprecated key overwrites new key; old config value used despite user setting new value

scenarios.description: State file read: load() returns cached _stateCache; in-memory state and disk state diverge
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Cache is invalidated on save; reads always return latest state; consistency between memory and disk
scenarios.failureMode: Stale cache returns old data after external write; bot operates on outdated state; missed position close
scenarios.prerequisites: External process modified state.json while bot is running
